**The question**

e.g. "what is the on-call rotation like"

**What `research` returned**

Include `keywords_tried`.

**The thread it should have found**

A Blind URL, if you have one.

This is the cheapest fix in the repo — usually one line in `_TOPIC_ALIASES` or
`_LOW_SIGNAL` plus a test. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
